title: Entropy News
description: Python research software for reproducing and extending the financial-news entropy methodology in Glasserman, Mamaysky, and Qin's New News is Bad News. The repository includes a strict rolling reproduction path for ENT, ENT_NEWS, and ENT_MODEL together with research and engineering extensions. Methodological reproduction does not by itself certify the provenance of proprietary Reuters source data.

creators.name: Ribeiro, Diogo
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Media Arts and Design, Technical University of Porto

references: Glasserman, Paul; Mamaysky, Harry; Qin, Jimmy (2023). New News is Bad News: Information, Expectations, and Financial Markets. SSRN 4555832. https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.4555832
